name: Dudhsagar Waterfalls (Sea of Milk)
opening_hours: 6:00 AM - 4:00 PM daily (Jeep safari operates from Kulem station · Closed in heavy peak monsoon for safety)
rules: Mandatory life-jacket rental required to swim in natural waterfall pool
Authorized Forest Department 4x4 jeeps only to navigate riverbed crossings
visual_features: roaring white cataract plunging 1,017 feet down green jungle cliffs spanned in the middle by an active arched railway bridge
description:
Dudhsagar Falls is a four-tiered waterfall on the Mahadayi River in the Indian state of Goa. It is 60km from Panaji by road and is located on the Belagavi–Vasco Da Gama rail route about 46km east of Madgaon and 80km south of Belagavi
. Dudhsagar Falls is perched at the top of a crescent shaped valley and surrounded by pristine forests, and it is amongst India's tallest waterfalls with a height of 310 m and an average width of 30 metres (100 feet).
